notes: Identity → Break-glass is new: declare your emergency-access Global Admins, track their 90-day validation, and follow a built-in best-practice guide for setting one up correctly.
Break-glass accounts no longer trip false alerts — they're excluded from the stale sign-in, Global Administrator count, and permanent-role drift findings.

Declared break-glass accounts are tagged with a Break-glass chip on every finding they appear in (Global Admins, privileged roles, MFA, stale identities), so you can spot them at a glance — updating instantly when you declare or remove one.
Identity-health findings now deep-link straight to the exact finding inside the tenant, not just the Identity tab.
